sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid. It preserves the ship target, required von Mises criterion, MPa quantity constraints, conditional beam-theory alternative, strict combined-stress comparison, correct allowable-stress direction, and tolerance-based yield-shear formula check using supported arithmetic and piecewise absolute-value logic.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the QUDT unit constraints: qudt:MegaPA expands to http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/MegaPA, but the verified recommended unit is http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/MegaPA, so use a separate unit prefix (for example unit:MegaPA) for every stress quantity. Preserve the ship target, conditional beam-theory alternative, strict combined-stress comparison, and tolerance-based derived yield-shear comparison.

The candidate omits the verified nltl:vonMisesYieldCriterion requirement term, although it is included in the requirement's legacyIndexedTerms and the comparison model explicitly conditions acceptance on using the von Mises yield criterion. Add this property on the ship with its verified xsd:string datatype and constrain it only to a verified controlled value if one is supplied; do not invent alternatives. Preserve the prior-valid ship target, conditional beam-theory alternative, strict combined-stress comparison, and tolerance-based derived yield-shear comparison.

Replace the unsupported SPARQL ABS calls in the derived yield-shear tolerance query with a supported bounded piecewise absolute-value expression using only permitted arithmetic, comparisons, and branches. Preserve the already-correct unit:MegaPA constraints on all stress quantities, ship target, vonMisesYieldCriterion presence, conditional beam-theory alternative, strict combined-stress comparison, and tolerance scaled from the expected yieldPoint/sqrt(3) result.

The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid. It preserves the ship target, required von Mises criterion, MPa quantity constraints, conditional beam-theory alternative, strict combined-stress comparison, correct allowable-stress direction, and tolerance-based yield-shear formula check using supported arithmetic and piecewise absolute-value logic.
